parameters.content:
## INACTIVE — fictional recovery
Manual trigger runs the original 59 checks plus shared-lock recovery tests; external test switch OFF.

E shares metadata ID 73015001 with D. A/C verify ownership. One due intake per run; no automatic lock expiry. A saves bounded retries; E resumes saved analysis and reconciles unfinished COMMAND receipts. Invalid checkpoints and orphan operations receive separate REVIEW tickets.

Schedule and Error Trigger are disabled. No workflow is assigned E as its error handler. n8n Error Trigger does not require publication, so inactive alone is not the activation gate.

Unknown child outcomes retain the lock. Error logging waits for ownership; busy/unavailable lock means no error row was saved. Raw error text, tokens and paid content are excluded. No Discord send nodes.
